verdict.rationale: This is a skill pack that runs inside coding agents, so the user's "data" is their codebase, issues and diffs. Several skills turn that data into AI-generated insights and suggestions: a refactoring-candidates visual report (docs-18), diff review against standards and spec (docs-14), issue triage that categorises, verifies and writes agent-ready briefs (docs-27), and grilling that proposes recommended answers (docs-53). These are prompt-driven workflows inside third-party agents, not a built-in insights layer over arbitrary user data. Missing for 10: a native in-product insights surface, analysis of data beyond code and issues, and hands-on or independent corroboration of output quality.
